get.description: Name/AppID search (legacy autocomplete). Ignores study filters and qualification.
Legacy 'Load game report': exact AppID, exact name, then best name match.

post.description: Uniformly pick one matching game and record it as shown in this session.
Record a manual lookup (shown in history and counted as seen, as in the legacy app).

put.description: Archive a game as a study. It is skipped by future suggestions (when that switch is on).

get.description:
Steam header artwork, proxied so the UI can draw it into the exported JPEG (browsers block
reading cross-origin images into a canvas). Kept in a small in-memory cache only.

post.description: The whole local dataset as CSV + JSON tables in one zip, for analysis in other tools.
Open one of the app's own folders in Explorer (Windows desktop convenience).
One request to Steam's app list to check the configured Web API key.

get.description:
Review/revenue snapshots for one game: the legacy import (date unknown) plus every
Steam refresh. Fewer than two dated points means there is no trend to show yet.

post.description:
Start (or refresh) the budget estimate or the review analysis for one game. Earlier runs
are kept.

recheck_unreleased.title: Recheck Unreleased
recheck_unreleased.description: Also re-check recently listed games that were not released

EconomicsView.title: EconomicsView
EconomicsView.description: Derived by the app (not the LLM) from team size x development time and the cost model.

Estimate.title: Estimate
Estimate.description: A researched quantity: range + best guess, with how sure we are and why.

LegacyRank.title: LegacyRank
LegacyRank.description: Yearly rank over the local catalog (equals the imported legacy rank until data changes).

ResearchFindings.title: ResearchFindings
ResearchFindings.description:
What the LLM returns. Each run kind fills its own part (see ``findings_json_schema``);
the other part keeps its empty defaults.

SettingsView.title: SettingsView
SettingsView.description: What the Settings dialog shows. Secrets are never returned - only whether they are set.

require_english.title: Require English
require_english.description: Exclude games known to have no English support

StudyFiltersModel.title: StudyFiltersModel
StudyFiltersModel.description: Legacy study filters. ``null`` numeric bound = field left empty (legacy fallback).
